name: CKM
summary: CKM, the muscle form of creatine kinase, on chromosome 10: an enzyme that regenerates ATP in muscle during very short, very hard effort. One variant, g.15884567G>A in intron 4 (EquCab2.0; BIEC2-109575), was reported by Gu et al. in 2010: the A allele was commoner among elite Thoroughbred racehorses than among horses that had never won. The result did not hold up in that study's own independent sample of 130 horses, and a later Quarter Horse study found no link with racing performance. It is a candidate that failed to replicate: no effect of either allele on speed, distance, stamina or anything else is established. T here is the A of the papers, the allele proposed as favourable, and C is their G.
